title: The Meta Ray-Ban Gen 2 AI glasses just dropped to $284
content_html:
Meta Ray-Ban Gen 2 glasses fall to a record low in early Black Friday deal

Published Nov 23, 2026, 10:54 AM EST

Timi is the news and deals reporter for Android Police, who has been reporting on technology since 2008. He has worked in tech retail and also the IT space, providing hardware and software support, which gives him a unique perspective on the tech that he covers. This allows him to effectively break down complex subjects into easy-to-read pieces that even casual readers can enjoy. In addition to writing for Android Police, he also makes contributions to XDA covering deals. He also worked as an editor and reporter for Neowin, where he covered news and attended major tech events like CES. He also reviewed phones, tablets, PC products, and other devices. In addition, he also created video content for the Neowin YouTube channel.

Sign in to your Android Police account

Smart glasses don't really have a good place in people's minds. So, you can understand why brands are so cautious when it comes to introducing a product of their own.

Meta knows this and has been cautiously building AI glasses for some years now, and has even partnered with Ray-Ban in order to make the concept more appealing.

For the most part, the brand is doing a good job with its offerings, improving with each iteration, while even offering something new in the same product category. If you've been thinking about giving AI glasses a shot, now's the time.

The best price we've seen

The Meta Ray-Ban (Gen 2) Wayfarer AI Glasses are now on sale during the Early Black Friday sale on Amazon, with the price dropping to $284 for a limited time. That's 25% off the usual retail price of $379, which is a significant chunk.

The glasses come with the traditional and classic Wayfarer design, while also packing a 12MP camera with five microphones that can capture 3K video. The glasses also feature open-ear speakers so you can listen to your music, and a touchpad for easy control.

You get up to eight hours of battery and an additional 48 hours with the included charging case. You also get hands-free operation with Meta AI, which can handle a variety of tasks, such as live translations, reminders, answers to questions, and more.

Now, this type of technology isn't always going to get the warmest reception, despite Meta working hard to get into a good place. Having a camera strapped to your face that can take photos and videos without much warning will create some noise.

It's a great way to capture scenes naturally, but some folks are still not happy with what these things can do. Of course, it's up to you whether you want to pick up a pair. They can be very handy. Samsung has also released a pair so that might be worth checking out.
